text: Cycling is a widely enjoyed sport and mode of transportation, utilizing a two-wheeled vehicle with a pedaling mechanism. Gear is an essential component of cycling, as it enables more efficient and diverse pedaling patterns, thereby enhancing performance and control in various terrains and conditions. Cyclists frequently employ a range of gears to modulate their speed and manage difficult paths. Safety is paramount while cycling, and protective gear, such as a helmet, is a must, as it safeguards the head from potential injuries in the event of an accident.
